title: Check: Ingress
description: Five questions on HTTP routing into the cluster.

questions.prompt: You create an Ingress and nothing happens. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: The Ingress needs a NodePort Service
The Ingress is in the wrong namespace

questions.explanation: The Ingress object is only a rule. Without a controller watching for it - ingress-nginx, Traefik - nothing acts on it.

options.text: Selects which controller should handle this Ingress

questions.explanation: It is how a cluster runs more than one controller without them both claiming every rule.

questions.prompt: How does an Ingress get its certificate?

options.text: From a Secret of type kubernetes.io/tls named in spec.tls

questions.explanation: The Secret holds tls.crt and tls.key and must live in the same namespace as the Ingress.

questions.prompt: What does `pathType: Prefix` mean for path `/api`?

options.text: /api and everything beneath it matches, split on path segments

questions.explanation: Exact matches only the literal path; ImplementationSpecific hands the decision to the controller.

questions.prompt: An Ingress rule points at a Service that has no ready endpoints. What does a client see?

options.text: Typically a 502 or 503 from the controller
A redirect to the default backend

questions.explanation: No healthy backend means a gateway error. Check the Service's EndpointSlices before blaming the Ingress.
